name: Paired Sixteen Child Bounds Tree

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: gpux BoundsTree insertion and end-to-end Test Suite WASM/WebGPU cadence
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Paired Sixteen-Child Bounds Tree Hypothesis

Increasing `MAX_CHILDREN` from 12 to 16 should reduce BoundsTree depth, search-node visits, and retained nodes enough to lower insertion self-time without materially regressing end-to-end wide DataTable throughput or paced p95 latency.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Change only the `MAX_CHILDREN` constant in `crates/gpux/crates/gpui/src/bounds_tree.rs` from 12 to 16. Preserve insertion ordering, intersection semantics, public APIs, diagnostics, tests, dependencies, configuration, and fixtures. Adjacent BoundsTree algorithm changes are forbidden.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Run formatting, focused BoundsTree tests, both gpux clippy feature matrices, the full gpux diagnostic suite, the gpui_wgpu diagnostic suite, and headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU with CPU profiles at DPR 1 and 2. Compare only with experiment 114. Accept only if insertion self-time decreases at both DPRs, deterministic search visits and retained nodes decrease, and neither throughput nor paced p95 regresses by more than 2% at either DPR. Require exact final rendering and zero errors.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

The wider node should exchange additional child evaluations per visited node for a shallower tree. A successful candidate will demonstrate that the structural reduction translates into lower insertion CPU cost while keeping end-to-end rendering cadence within the strict paired non-regression gate.

counters: 504 insertions and zero terminal error at both DPRs

reportMarkdown:
# Experiment 115 Report

The one-line 16-child candidate passed formatting, both clippy feature matrices, all three focused BoundsTree tests, 419 gpux tests, 52 gpui_wgpu tests, and both headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU cases with exact final rendering.

The deterministic structure changed as predicted: search visits fell from 4,440 to 3,343 (-24.707%), retained nodes fell from 576 to 559 (-2.951%), and child evaluations increased from 14,351 to 16,348 (+13.915%).

The performance gate failed at DPR 1. Throughput fell from 29.0631 to 22.4587 steps/s (-22.724%), paced p95 worsened from 27.7590 to 35.4067 ms (+27.550%), and sampled insertion self-time increased from 155.246 to 176.817 ms (+13.896%). DPR 2 was nearly neutral: throughput +0.971%, paced p95 -1.235%, and insertion self-time -0.819%.

Because insertion self-time did not improve at both DPRs and the DPR 1 end-to-end regressions exceeded 2%, the candidate was rejected and the source was restored to the exact checkpoint state.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Reject the 16-child BoundsTree candidate. Its shallower structure does not reliably translate to lower insertion CPU cost and materially degrades DPR 1 rendering cadence. Restore `MAX_CHILDREN` to 12 and close this width-only branch; any different tree-search mechanism must be a new experiment.
